description: Finds free public APIs matching a topic, ranked by measured uptime. Filter to only those needing no API key, or only those above an uptime threshold. Use this when you need an API for a task and want one that currently works.

category.description: Restrict to one category. Call list_categories for valid values.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Default 10, max 50.

no_auth_only.description: Only return APIs that need no API key or signup. Default false.

query.description: What you need, e.g. 'weather forecast', 'movie metadata', 'currency exchange'. Optional if category is given.

name: search_free_apis
title: Search free public APIs by need
